1.2.Trillium Residencies Limited is a fully owned subsidiary of City Housing and Real Estate Company PLC. City Housing & Real
Estate Company PLC became the holding Company of Trillium Residences Ltd. in financial year ended 31st March 2005.
1.3.Basis of Consolidation
Subsidiaries are controlled by the Company. Control exists when the Company has the power, directly or indirectly to govern
